verdict.rationale: Dagster offers a Python SDK (dg/dagster core APIs), an AI skill for coding agents, and an official MCP server for Dagster+, showing real investment in AI-native tooling, but these are docs/skills rather than a dedicated multi-language 'AI SDK' with client libraries for building agentic workflows. missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of the AI skill and MCP server actually working, evidence of SDKs beyond Python, and any agent-framework-specific SDK bindings.
